title: work
description: An abstract book: title, authors, series membership. Narrations live in sibling recording records.

authors.description: The work's authors as person slugs. The slug is the identity, so the list may not repeat one.

credits.description: Contributors credited in a role that is not authorship: translator, editor, illustrator and the rest of the controlled vocabulary. Optional and purely additive - authors stays the identity list, and a person credited here is NOT removed from it when a source names them as both. Omitted unless a source STATED the role; never inferred.

genres.description: The work's genres, drawn from this project's own normalized vocabulary (never a retailer's taxonomy). Optional: omit it rather than guess.

added_at.description: When this work entered the database. Stamped at creation by the importer and the intake bot as a plain date; records dated by the one-time git-history backfill carry that commit's full timestamp verbatim. Optional, since records predating the field carry none.

recordings.description: The work's recordings, keyed by recording slug. Present only in a works-family pack entry, where the map key replaces the recording's filename; a standalone work record never carries it.
